aboutMe.text1: Hello! My name is Loïc, I am currently in the early stages of my 2nd year of a 3-year engineering program in computer science. I am passionate about web and mobile application development, and I enjoy creating innovative applications that meet users' needs.
aboutMe.text2: Outside of my studies, I enjoy exploring new technologies and learning new skills. I am also a big fan of video games, which has inspired me to develop interactive and fun applications.
aboutMe.text3: I am always looking for new opportunities to collaborate on exciting projects and to continue developing my programming skills.
